Assist a home sale and purchase with Claude
A homeowner used Claude to choose agents, analyze the market, track key dates, review contracts, and prepare mortgage documentation.
·
Oct 1, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
A commenter who made a cross-country move said they used Claude throughout the home sale and purchase process. They had it help select and evaluate agents for selling and buying, analyze the market to shape a sales strategy, track important dates, review contracts, and prepare documentation for mortgage agents.
How it went
They said it was a tremendous help and that the overall plan went off without a hitch. The thread gives no metrics, detailed workflow, or specific problems Claude failed on.
Worth knowing
The source is very thin: it names the tasks Claude helped with, but does not say which model, what prompts or files were used, or how much time or money it saved.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
I'm selling my home at [address] and buying a new one in [area], with a target timeline of [dates]. Help me with each stage: compare real estate agents using these notes [paste notes], summarize the market from these comps [paste data], build a calendar of key dates and deadlines, flag unusual or risky clauses in the contracts I paste in, and list the mortgage documents I need to gather. Finish with a one-page checklist and timeline I can follow, and don't treat anything as legal advice without telling me what to confirm with my agent or attorney.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xjozvf/claude_ai_in_real_estate
